order: Run the WO-11 Band A exercises and record every outcome in full. The Conductor's session must be audited against the role's guardrails and every violation found must receive a ruled disposition — the audit must be a full written record, never a summary. The P0 substrate must be live-exercised end to end and the run must produce its own written report. The Architect role must also be attempted; if the environment blocks it, the blocked attempt must be preserved as its own transcript rather than discarded, and a repeated attempt must keep a second transcript rather than overwrite the first. The band record and status summary must be updated to the real per-seat outcomes only — no placeholder or aspirational line may remain. The substrate's test suite may be extended only as far as the exercise runs require; the substrate's production behavior must stay unchanged.
claims: We audited the Conductor's transcript and ruled dispositions for the one violation found, recorded in a 569-line written audit. The P0 substrate was live-exercised end to end and its 340-line report checked in. The Architect exercise was attempted twice; the environment blocked it both times, and both 30-line transcripts were kept as the record rather than merged into one. The status summary and band record were updated to the true per-seat outcomes, and the test suite gained 31 lines of exercise-support changes only.
